title: Senior Lease Administration Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.</li> <li>Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.</li> <li>Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.</li> <li>Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.</li> <li>Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.</li> <li>Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.</li> <li>Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.</li> <li>Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.</li> <li>Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.</li> <li>Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.</li> <li>Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.</li> <li>Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.</li> <li>Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.</li> <li>Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.</li> <li>Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.</li> <li>Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.</li> <li>Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.</li> <li>You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>You have a proactive mindset with a track record of identifying gaps and driving solutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements. </em></p> <p><strong>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. title: Senior Director - EMEA Enterprise Business Development
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Senior Director, Enterprise Business Development – EMEA will report to the Vice President and Managing Director, EMEA and lead the strategy and execution model for CoreWeave’s Enterprise business across the region.</p> <p>This is a business development and strategy leadership role that works through CoreWeave’s field organisation. Country sales teams will retain account ownership, opportunity management and revenue responsibility, while you define the Enterprise strategy, customer propositions, industry points of view, sales plays and adoption mechanisms that enable them to win and grow strategic Enterprise customers.</p> <p>You will work closely with Field Sales, Product, Field Engineering, Product and Field Marketing, partners and customers to build a differentiated Enterprise narrative and translate it into repeatable field execution. You will also build and lead a team of Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to priority vertical industries, bringing deep expertise in how AI will reshape those sectors.</p> <h2><strong>In This Role, You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and execute CoreWeave’s EMEA Enterprise business development strategy in partnership with regional and country sales leadership.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s Enterprise point of view, including Enterprise architecture, market segmentation, AI wallet distribution, buying centres, workload evolution and competitive positioning.</li> <li>Define how CoreWeave participates in the Enterprise AI transformation journey, from initial AI initiatives through production adoption, operationalisation and scaled Enterprise Intelligence.</li> <li>Develop the narrative for how CoreWeave enables customers to operate their AI Learning Loops, positioning the platform as the infrastructure, software and operational foundation through which organisations continuously build, deploy, learn and improve.</li> <li>Build a systematic view of Enterprise AI adoption across EMEA, including where investment is occurring, which workloads are moving into production, how budgets are shifting and where CoreWeave can gain market share.</li> <li>Define Enterprise segmentation and prioritisation models that help field teams identify the customers, industries, workloads and buying centres with the greatest strategic and commercial potential.</li> <li>Develop CoreWeave’s Enterprise sales plays, including target customer profiles, business triggers, technical use cases, executive value propositions, competitive positioning and expansion motions.</li> <li>Own the development of Enterprise sales content, executive narratives, pitch decks and field assets in partnership with Field and Product Marketing.</li> <li>Build a repeatable Enterprise adoption methodology that helps customers progress from initial workload evaluation through production deployment, scaled consumption and broader platform adoption.</li> <li>Develop programmes that enable customers to adopt CoreWeave as a strategic component of their AI architecture rather than as a point solution for individual workloads.</li> <li>Partner with Product leadership to ensure CoreWeave’s Enterprise strategy reflects product capabilities, roadmap direction and the requirements of large-scale Enterprise customers.</li> <li>Translate customer and market insight into clear recommendations for product investment, developer experience, security, governance, observability, integration and Enterprise platform capabilities.</li> <li>Work closely with Field Engineering to define Enterprise adoption strategies using Forward Deployed Engineers, specialist technical resources and services.</li> <li>Build repeatable engagement models that combine business, technical and operational resources around the most important Enterprise transformation opportunities.</li> <li>Partner with Field Sales leaders to translate Enterprise strategy into country and account-level execution, ensuring sellers understand where to focus, what to lead with and how to progress customers through the adoption journey.</li> <li>Work with partners to build joint Enterprise propositions, solution patterns and routes to market that accelerate customer adoption and extend CoreWeave’s reach.</li> <li>Maintain executive-level relationships with strategic Enterprise customers, technology partners and ecosystem leaders.</li> <li>Act as an executive sponsor for strategically important Enterprise transformation opportunities.</li> <li>Build and maintain an active graph of Enterprise AI adoption across the region, mapping customers, industries, workloads, AI investment, architecture choices, partners, competitors and stages of maturity.</li> <li>Build, lead and develop a team of Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to priority industry segments.</li> <li>Ensure each industry leader develops a differentiated view of how AI will reshape their sector, including priority use cases, economic impact, data and infrastructure requirements, buying centres, barriers to adoption and relevant ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Establish a rigorous operating cadence and scorecard covering market penetration, Enterprise adoption, field execution, pipeline influence, consumption, revenue performance and market share.</li> <li>Represent CoreWeave’s Enterprise narrative externally with customers, partners, industry bodies, analysts, media and at major industry events.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Objectives</strong></h2> <p>During the first 12 months, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Define CoreWeave’s EMEA Enterprise strategy, operating plan and growth priorities.</li> <li>Establish a clear Enterprise segmentation model covering priority industries, customers, workloads and buying centres.</li> <li>Develop CoreWeave’s Enterprise architecture and AI transformation points of view.</li> <li>Define the Enterprise AI Learning Loop narrative and articulate how CoreWeave becomes the ways and means through which customers operate and scale those loops.</li> <li>Build the initial Enterprise sales plays, executive narratives, sales content and pitch materials required by field teams.</li> <li>Develop and launch a repeatable Enterprise adoption methodology covering evaluation, production deployment, expansion and scaled adoption.</li> <li>Define the engagement model for Forward Deployed Engineers, Field Engineering and services within strategic Enterprise opportunities.</li> <li>Build and maintain the first regional Enterprise AI adoption graph, identifying market penetration, wallet distribution, major workloads, competitive positions and whitespace.</li> <li>Establish the vertical industry strategy and determine the first priority industry segments.</li> <li>Hire and onboard the initial Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to those industries.</li> <li>Build executive relationships with an initial set of strategic Enterprise customers and partners.</li> <li>Establish the business review cadence, measurement framework and market-share methodology for the Enterprise segment.</li> <li>Demonstrate measurable contribution to Enterprise pipeline, adoption, consumption and overall EMEA Enterprise revenue performance.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise business development, go-to-market strategy, sales, industry leadership, consulting or product strategy within cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, AI or another complex technology environment.</li> <li>Significant experience defining and executing Enterprise growth strategies across multiple markets or industries.</li> <li>A proven record of translating market and customer insight into repeatable sales plays, adoption programmes and measurable commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how large Enterprises evaluate, adopt, govern and scale new technology platforms.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Enterprise architecture, cloud industry-specific strategies or leading business development across major Enterprise verticals.</li> <li>Strong analytical capability, with the ability to build market models, adoption frameworks, segmentation strategies and executive-level business reviews.</li> <li>Experience building, hiring, coaching and developing high-performing business development, strategy or industry teams.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead through influence across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing and partner organisations.</li> <li>A record of operating successfully across EMEA markets and cultures, with the ability to travel regularly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Leadership experience in Enterprise strategy, business development, industry go-to-market or sales at a major title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3>           <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you'll raise the bar for how AI gets built, governed, and evaluated across the team. You'll define standards that other engineers adopt, such as evaluation methodologies for agents and MLOps practices, while acting as the senior technical voice for the most sensitive AI decisions our clients face.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define standards for responsible AI, model governance, and production MLOps that get adopted broadly across the Global Public Sector team</li> <li>Build or validate the highest-risk parts of strategic AI systems and use those systems to establish standards other teams can adopt.</li> <li>Architect AI systems designed to prevent systemic failure, and lead the resolution of the most severe incidents tied to model safety or data integrity</li> <li>Build reusable AI capabilities, such as production-ready agent implementations built on proven architectures, fine-tuned models, or evaluation methodologies, that other engineers and clients can build on</li> <li>Advise on which new AI developments are worth adopting, and help set the technical roadmap for the domain</li> <li>Act as the senior technical partner to client leadership on AI strategy</li> <li>Coach Senior Applied AI Engineers, delegate ownership of technical domains, and build systems and practices that enable multiple teams to deliver safer AI</li> <li>Contribute to recruiting and representing Scale's AI work externally</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive engineering experience, with a multi-year track record owning AI/ML systems in production</li> <li>Experience judging the quality of training data, selecting the right adaptation method for a given model, evaluating fine-tuning results, and balancing serving cost, latency, and quality trade-offs</li> <li>Experience owning an AI-powered product end to end, including direct involvement in the AI's behaviour rather than implementing ML work scoped by another team</li> <li>A track record of establishing standards that outlived the projects they were built under pressure</li> <li>Deep experience with regulated, sovereign, or on-premise AI deployment, including hallucination mitigation and auditability</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where this role sits</strong></p> <p>Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Some UK assignments require BPSS screening and may require SC or DV clearance. Requirements depend on the account and each candidate's circumstances. We discuss assignment-specific eligibility early in the hiring process.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. title: Model Developer (Client Education)
description: Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. I joined four years ago as a Curriculum Developer and have spent the last couple of years growing Client Education into the (soon to be) five-person team it is today. Before hx I spent a decade teaching Computing in secondary schools. Outside of work most of my time goes to my two children, and what's left to running and, more recently, mountain biking - where I'm still very much a beginner. Client Education exists to get our customers to value as quickly as possible, and to keep them there. We run instructor-led training, own hx Academy where all our self-paced learning content lives, own the certification programme, and run some of our customer events. We've also recently taken ownership of Developer+, and that's where this role comes in. Our first customers are working through the programme now, and as it grows it will need to evolve based on what we learn from them. This isn't a typical Delivery Engineer role, you'll sit in Client Education rather than Delivery Engineering. You'll still work closely with the wider Delivery Engineering team, but your day to day is the customers on Developer+: delivering workshops, running drop-ins, reviewing their code, and shaping the programme around what you learn doing it. You'll partner with Product too, so customers can adopt new enhancements quickly and smoothly. There's no established playbook for this yet, so what matters most is the drive to build one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to own, I'd love to hear from you. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes, like whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We’re already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Delivery Engineering team The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that). We specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do. The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries. What you'll be doing Move customer teams from hx-led build to independent delivery, shifting effort from pairing toward review and advisory. Keep every engagement moving to its prescribed path, sequencing services to each customer's build stage. Deliver structured enablement sessions; architecture, coding best practice, testing and deployment, model lifecycles. Run code review as a consistent, standards-anchored service, evolving hx's model development standards where reviews expose gaps. Provide drop-in support shaped by each customer's build stage, resolving most issues in session rather than escalating. Make Developer+ repeatable rather than personality-dependent, documenting delivery and using AI to scale capacity. Convert delivery knowledge into hx Academy content, prioritised by what reviews and drop-ins actually surface. Act as the technical voice of the customer into Product, feeding back recurring friction on a regular rhythm. What you'll need to have done Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments, including testing, deployment and model lifecycles. Have excellent pricing and modelling judgement when working with customer’s - working with insurance & actuarial teams is a plus. Developed strong technical enablement instincts, pitching sessions and documentation at the audience's real level. Coached customer teams to work independently rather than solving problems for them. Operated with high ownership and self-direction, building repeatable process where none exists. Prioritised transparently across competing delivery, review and content demands. Communicated with credibility and clarity across developers, actuaries, delivery partners and internal stakeholders. title: Associate Director, Operational Risk Management
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the team The Global Risk team at Airwallex plays a critical role in enabling the company's growth by building a strong, scalable, and globally consistent approach to risk management. The team works across the business to define risk appetite, develop frameworks and policies, support strategic decision-making, and provide oversight of key risks as Airwallex expands across products, markets, and regulatory environments. You'll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you'll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale. How you'll make impact You'll own the Group's Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Incident Management framework as part of the Second Line of Defence, and provide independent, consolidated oversight of how the First Line identifies, assesses, and manages risk across Group entities. Own the Group RCSA and incident management frameworks: Maintain the methodologies, standards, policies, taxonomy, guidance, templates, and supporting procedures for the Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and for identifying, recording, investigating, and reporting operational risk events, keeping them current and aligned with Group operating models, risk appetite, local entity requirements, and relevant regulatory expectations. Drive consistency across the Group: Promote consistent risk assessment, incident classification, and ownership across business units and Group entities. Provide independent review and challenge: Challenge First Line risk assessments, control ratings, incident classification, root-cause analysis, and remediation plans, ensuring they are timely, evidence-based, proportionate, and comparable across the business. Govern the lifecycle and drive actions to closure: Support governance of RCSA frequency, approvals, and evidence standards, and track actions arising from RCSAs and incidents through to completion, escalating overdue items with clear accountability. Turn data into insight and decision-ready MI: Analyse RCSA, incident, and loss data to identify trends, themes, and systemic control weaknesses, escalate repeat issues to the right owners and governance forums, and produce clear reporting and recommended actions for Operational Risk reporting, governance forums, and relevant risk management committees. Support regulatory notification: Work with Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Legal, and First Line teams so material incidents are assessed and notified to the relevant regulators on time, in line with Group and local regulatory expectations. Enable the First Line: Give practical guidance on risk identification, assessment, incident reporting standards, and root-cause methodologies. Run workshops, training, and coaching so that RCSAs are a useful management tool rather than a compliance exercise and high-quality incident reporting becomes business as usual. Maintain a clear 1LoD / 2LoD line: Keep ownership and accountability between First Line risk and control owners and Second Line oversight explicit and well documented. You'll report to the Head of Operational Risk and work remotely, with occasional travel to London. What we're looking for Essentials 10+ years of progressive experience in operational risk management and controls within a financial services group, with proven experience in a Second Line (2LoD) capacity. RCSA Programme Expertise: Experience designing, and implementing, RCSA programmes in a regulated financial services environment. Control Design & Effectiveness: Strong understanding of control design and control effectiveness assessment, including how residual risk is rated and challenged. Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of Group and local regulatory expectations relating to operational risk and control frameworks, and how to apply Group-wide methodologies to local entity requirements. Data & Analytical Skills: Ability to analyse risk data, identify trends and emerging issues, and communicate findings clearly. Facilitation & Stakeholder Management: Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and influence senior First Line leaders. Documentation Discipline: Ability to produce clear, practical, and well-maintained framework documentation, standards, and guidance. Direct experience building or deploying AI agents. Preferred Fintech / Hyper-Growth Background: Prior experience designing or scaling operational risk frameworks within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, or cloud-native technology company. Multi-Entity / Global Exposure: Experience applying a Group framework across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions, and regulators. Tooling Familiarity: Experience with GRC platforms and BI dashboards to support RCSA workflows, reporting, and action tracking. Professional Background & Certifications: Prior experience in a Big Four / top-tier consultancy, alongside relevant qualifications such as CRISC, IRM Certificate, or equivalent. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next B2B Marketing Graduate.</span></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">HRtechX is part of United Media (</span><a href="https://www.united-media.com/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">https://www.united-media.com/</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. </span></p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What we expect from you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Startdate</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer
description: <p>Data is the foundation of every trading decision we make. From financial instruments and corporate actions to market calendars, counterparty data, and alternative datasets, the breadth and complexity of reference data continues to grow alongside the increasing sophistication and interconnected nature of global markets. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Global Data Engineering team to expand the coverage, quality, and robustness of our reference data products, which power low, medium, and high frequency trading strategies across the firm.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish vision and technical direction for major initiatives across our reference data platform</li> <li>Expand and harden existing reference data products — improving coverage across asset classes and datasets, raising data quality, and increasing operational robustness</li> <li>Design, develop, support, and maintain critical components of our data infrastructure that traders and researchers rely on every day</li> <li>Ensure new and existing programs adhere to our coding, architectural, and operational standards</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of trading, exchanges, and the diverse data domains that underpin them</li> <li>Collaborate deeply with traders, engineers, and researchers to identify gaps, prioritise improvements, and deliver datasets that meet the bar of a top-tier trading firm</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong engineering instincts and a deep understanding of computer science fundamentals</li> <li>Experience writing software in C++, C, C# and/or Python</li> <li>Innovative, big-picture thinking grounded in real-world pragmatism</li> <li>Desire to continuously improve in a rapidly evolving environment</li> <li>Readiness to set technical direction, promote engineering principles, and do the right things</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p>At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.</p> <p><strong>What you'll get</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="197">You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. title: Machine Learning Scientist, Generative Modelling
description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for a Machine Learning Scientist to help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour. Your work will be central to our mission to understand and control cellular decision-making, enabling novel therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models. You'll be joining a team with access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced computational infrastructure, and deep interdisciplinary expertise. We embrace modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows, to accelerate the pace of research iteration. This is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what generative modelling can achieve in complex, high-dimensional, and noisy real-world systems, and to see your work tested directly in experimental biology. Day to day, you will Design and implement generative modelling approaches that learn intervention effects from diverse biological data, including single-cell perturbation experiments. Develop models that go beyond correlation, focusing on generalisation, counterfactual prediction, and experimental design. Collaborate with experimental teams to design and validate computational hypotheses via iterative strategies that identify the highest-signal next experiment. title: Senior Staff Engineer - Payments
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🎯 The Role We're hiring a Senior Staff Engineer for our brand new Payments squad, part of Saldo, our Billing and Payments Service. Payments at tem works today, but it's a basic service. We're growing fast, and it needs to be built for the scale we're moving towards. You'll be the first tech lead in a squad that already has a senior engineer and three junior engineers, and you'll own the outcome of the squad's delivery and the standards it works to. This is a hands-on role. You'll write design docs, review code, solve the hardest problems alongside the team, and set the technical direction for payments. The number you'll move is the cost of processing every pound that flows through tem. Your job is to bring it down, and keep it low as we scale. In your first 12 months, you might: Set the architecture direction that takes payments from a functional service to one built for growth. Define how the squad works, including the balance between speed, quality and resilience that payments demands. Lift the quality and speed bar for the whole squad, senior and junior engineers alike. Drive the technical blockers to delivery to resolution, so the squad's work reaches the people who depend on it. Make payment accuracy and processing efficiency the levers that bring cost-to-process down. You'll report into the Service Manager for Saldo. 🛠️ Responsibilities Own the outcome: Take responsibility for the squad's delivery and the standards it works to, so the team ships work we're proud of. Lead from the front line: Write specs and design docs, give feedback on ADRs, review pull requests, and solve problems directly through code or workflows. Set the payments architecture direction: Turn a genuinely ambiguous area into a clear technical strategy, without waiting for someone else to define the problem. Cut the cost to process: Own payment accuracy and processing efficiency as the direct levers on cost-to-process. Design how the squad works: Define the squad's operating model and set the pace, rather than waiting for a playbook. Own the big picture: Manage sequencing and dependencies, diagnose why throughput isn't improving, and make sure the squad's work is visible to stakeholders. Build a high-performance team: Coach junior engineers while working the hardest problems alongside our senior engineer, and define what good looks like by working the details with the team. Partner on people decisions: Flag promotion and hiring gaps to your manager, who keeps line management and performance conversations. Decisions on people are made jointly. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves A track record as a Staff Engineer, owning the outcome of a squad's delivery and the standards it works to. A track record of leading from the front line: writing design docs, reviewing PRs and ADRs, and solving problems hands-on while setting direction. The ability to balance hands-on work on the biggest technical challenges with coaching more junior engineers, holding the whole team to a consistent quality and speed bar. Experience designing a team's ways of working from scratch, balancing speed, quality and resilience. Experience owning cross-team sequencing and dependencies, and diagnosing throughput problems rather than just reporting them. It's preferred that someone has deep experience with Python (FastAPI) and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React, however we're open to people who demonstrate the ability to be tech agnostic. Comfort cutting through real ambiguity to set technical direction, and driving technical blockers to resolution rather than just visibility. For this position, we are ideally seeking someone who comes from the payments industry and can help make it a competitive advantage. Desirable Experience improving cost-to-process or processing efficiency in a high-volume service. Experience taking a service from a basic first version to something built for scale. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Competitive salary. Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process First call with our Talent Team (30 mins). Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 mins). Technical Interview with Martin and/or Pawel (90 mins). You will discuss system design and have a technical Q&A. Culture-Add Interview with Product and Leadership stakeholders (45 mins). We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. Compensation: £117,850 • Offers Equity • Base Salary £117,850 • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior UX Design Engineer
description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: 🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. 🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. 🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. 💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. Role Overview 🔎 As a Senior UX Design Engineer, you'll own some of the hardest problems in our product and see them through until they're solved. You'll join our design team, three designers today and growing, and work inside our teams alongside product managers and our product, legal and AI engineers (our legal engineers are former real estate lawyers). We've built a product that real estate lawyers rely on, and now we're also building for the businesses that own, occupy and develop property. You'll work across both, and much of it is new ground. Nobody here has the full answer yet, and that's the job: you'll get to know the people we build for, work out what they need from us, and build it. This role is not about polishing screens. Our product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate lawyers and property teams in the world. The hardest design problems here are not about how it looks. They are about whether people can trust it and get their work done. Your starting point is the users, their work and the product: you notice what isn't working, decide what matters most, and see it through, from the first customer conversation to the version they use. Here, designers build what they design. With AI coding tools, you'll build your designs into the product yourself, often live for customers the next day. When anyone can build, judgement matters most, and that is the heart of this role. What You'll Be Doing Find out who you're building for: talk to customers and map who does what inside law firms and property businesses. You'll do it together with the wider team. Design how people work with our AI agents, which do real work on their behalf: what people hand over, how they check it and see where each answer came from, when they step in, what the agent asks about first and what it simply does, and how that shifts as AI improves. Solve first, then refine: get to the right answer with rough, working versions in front of real people, and add polish once the problem is solved. Build and ship interface changes yourself, using AI coding tools in our codebase. Engineering depth is welcome, not required. Keep the product coherent while everyone builds: engineers, legal engineers, product people and coding agents all build interfaces here. Explain why one option beats another so people can make the call themselves, write it down as clear, reusable rules in the codebase for agents to follow, and evolve our design system so it all still feels like one product. New to design engineering? 🌱 Design engineering is still a new kind of role, and most great candidates won't have had the title. If you're a strong designer with a good sense of product, and you're excited about building what you design, we'd love to hear from you. We'll help you make the shift. You should apply if: ✍️ You go after the hard problem, not the surface one, and own it until it's solved. You judge your work by whether people use it, rely on it and come back. You're comfortable not knowing yet. You form a view, test it with real people, and change it when they tell you something different. You bring design excellence and strong product sense: hierarchy, layout, type, copy, states, navigation and flow, and a clear view of what is worth building. You've designed for experts, people who know their field better than any designer will. You reach for patterns they already know, and never talk down to them. You can say why. You make a call and ship it without waiting for sign-off, explain it in words others can reuse, and change your mind for a good reason. You'd rather guide people than overrule them. You're genuinely excited about AI: what it can do, where it's heading and how to get the most out of it. You already design or build with AI tools, at work or in your own projects, and you want to help shape how AI changes the working day of property professionals. You want to learn how property and legal work gets done. No legal or property knowledge needed. You have owned and shipped product design work, and can walk us through the problem, not just the result. Desirable Experience designing AI products: showing the reasoning behind an answer, signalling confidence, and letting people steer an agent. Experience in legal tech, fintech, compliance or another field where precision and professional accountability shape every decision. Side projects, hackathons or things you've built outside work. Design systems and accessibility experience. Experience at an early-stage or fast-scaling startup, where there was no established process and you helped create one. Reasons we might not be for you The pace is fast and our ways of working keep evolving. If you prefer clear boundaries between design and engineering, this may not be the role for you. You'll spend most of your time on hard, unsolved problems and on building, not on perfecting polished mock-ups. Why you'll love it here You'll join a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real. You'll help shape how design works in a company where AI builds alongside people. Your work is used by lawyers and property teams on real deals and real buildings. How we hire A short call with our recruiter. A 30-minute video call with the hiring manager. A design task. A 90-minute panel: you'll walk us through your task, then meet people from across the company. A final conversation with our CTO. Read more How we think about design engineering: Design After the Leap Everyone Ships Code Now Our Product Engineering Guide Benefits 🌟 💰 Competitive salary 🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 📚 £1,000 personal development budget and learning opportunities 🏥 Company pension, healthcare, eye care and enhanced parental leave 🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays, and a Deliveroo budget for late nights 🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme 🎉 Regular team off-sites, shared lunches and social events 🧑‍💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're big on working together in person. This role is based in our London office, several days a week. 🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. 💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife About the team We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa. Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on. You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD. The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage. The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively. You’ll also be part of a strong iOS engineering community, contributing to standards, sharing knowledge and helping us continue to mature our native engineering practice. A Day in the life: Partner closely with the Engineering Manager, Principal Mobile Engineer and Head of Mobile Engineering to deliver Zopa’s mobile strategy. Help shape the technical direction and standards for iOS across Zopa. Design and evolve shared modules, APIs, architecture and developer tooling that enable multiple teams to build and ship with confidence. Identify technical risks early, using data, profiling and observability to improve performance, reliability and developer experience. Stay highly hands-on, delivering production-quality Swift and SwiftUI code across platform and customer-facing product work. Raise the capability of other engineers through pairing, code reviews, technical discussions and knowledge sharing. Work closely with Product, Design, Backend and Android colleagues to make well-rounded decisions, influence direction and respect each discipline’s expertise. About you: Strong experience building and maintaining customer-facing iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Deep knowledge of iOS development, including concurrency, performance, memory management, testing, accessibility and security. Sound architectural and API-design judgement, with a focus on simple, maintainable solutions and an excellent developer experience. A proactive engineer who identifies problems, shapes practical solutions and influences improvements beyond their immediate team. A collaborative teammate who raises the capability of others through coaching, pairing and knowledge sharing. Comfortable constructively challenging ideas, while remaining open-minded and willing to change course when better evidence emerges. Genuine curiosity about mobile engineering and the evolving iOS platform. Added bonus: Background in fintech, banking or another regulated, high-trust environment where reliability and customer confidence matter. A track record of building shared libraries, platform capabilities or design systems that help engineering teams move faster. Strong hands-on knowledge of UIKit and its place within modern iOS development. Proven impact improving mobile CI/CD pipelines, release processes and developer tooling.
